Body.Content:
The Azure log integration (AzLog) tool will be deprecated on June 15, 2019.  The deprecation timeline had been announced a year earlier in June 2018.

The AzLog tool had enabled customers to collect logs from Azure Resource Manager and other Azure resources into their Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) products for security analysis. AzLog is being replaced with an approach of using Azure Monitor and Azure Event Hubs to export logs coupled with Azure connectors from SIEM vendors that enable collecting these into the SIEM product.

Learn more
